name: rosetta-exponential-digital-sums
code:
use default

digit_sum(digits: string) -> int =>
    digits |> reduce(0, (sum, c) => sum + cast int(c) - cast int('0'))

exponents(n: int, highest: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let value = bigint(n)
    let power mut = value

    for e in 2::highest do
        power = power * value

        if digit_sum("{power}") == n then
            yield e
        fi
    od
si

report(wanted: int, least_ways: int, highest: int) is
    let found mut = 0
    let n mut = 1

    while found < wanted do
        n = n + 1

        let ways = exponents(n, highest) |> collect_list()

        if ways.count >= least_ways then
            found = found + 1

            write_line(ways |> map(e => "{n}^{e}") |> join(", "))
        fi
    od
si

write_line("first twenty:")

report(20, 1, 100)

write_line()
write_line("first ten in three or more ways:")

report(10, 3, 500)
